intro: Texas gives you three things at unusual scale. The Houston Ship Channel is the busiest petrochemical waterway in the country and its Vessel Traffic Service is genuinely gripping to follow. Severe weather here is on another level, so the NOAA transmitters and the amateur SKYWARN nets matter more than almost anywhere else. And San Antonio's ring of Air Force bases puts a great deal of training traffic on the military AM band, which your VX-6 covers.
introz: 德州有三样规模异常的东西。休斯顿航道是全美最繁忙的石化水道，它的船舶交通管理服务听起来相当扣人心弦。这里的恶劣天气完全是另一个量级，所以 NOAA 发射台和业余 SKYWARN 通联网比几乎任何地方都重要。而圣安东尼奥周边一圈空军基地在军用 AM 波段上产生大量训练通话，VX-6 正好能覆盖。

stations.z: 休斯顿航道交管 11 频道
stations.d: A narrow, crowded, fifty-mile channel carrying tankers and chemical ships past refineries, with pilots, tugs and traffic control coordinating continuously. Set up near the Fred Hartman Bridge or the Lynchburg ferry and this becomes some of the most absorbing radio in the country. Scan 156.300–157.400 to find the sector in use.
stations.dz: 一条狭窄拥挤、长约五十英里的航道，油轮和化学品船穿行于炼油厂之间，引航员、拖轮和交通管制持续协调。在 Fred Hartman 桥或 Lynchburg 渡口附近守听，这会成为全美最令人入迷的无线电内容之一。扫 156.300–157.400 找当前在用的分区。

stations.d: Where the actual passing arrangements get made. Essential listening alongside the VTS channel.
stations.dz: 真正商定会让方案的频道。与交管频道配合收听是必需的。

stations.z: NOAA 休斯顿 / 加尔维斯顿
stations.d: Hurricane warnings, flash flooding and coastal surge. Galveston has a long history with all three.
stations.dz: 飓风警报、暴洪和风暴潮。加尔维斯顿在这三件事上都有漫长的历史。

stations.d: North Texas sits in the southern end of Tornado Alley. SAME alerts on this transmitter will wake you up before your phone does.
stations.dz: 北德州位于龙卷风走廊南端。这个发射台上的 SAME 警报会比手机更早把你叫醒。

stations.z: NOAA 奥斯汀 / 圣安东尼奥
stations.d: The Hill Country is the flash-flood capital of the United States. This matters if you are anywhere near a low water crossing.
stations.dz: 山丘乡是全美暴洪最严重的地区。如果你在任何低洼过水路面附近，这一点很重要。

stations.d: Seven runways and separate tower positions. Sweep 118–128 MHz. The Founders Plaza observation area is purpose-built for this.
stations.dz: 七条跑道，塔台分席位运行。扫 118–128 MHz。Founders Plaza 观景区就是为此而建的。

stations.n: San Antonio military UHF — scan 225–380 MHz
stations.z: 圣安东尼奥军用 UHF · 扫 225–380 MHz
stations.d: Randolph, Lackland and Joint Base San Antonio run continuous pilot training. Set the VX-6 to AM and sweep the military band — the volume of instructional traffic is unlike anything on the civil side. Laughlin and Sheppard further out are also training bases.
stations.dz: Randolph、Lackland 和 Joint Base San Antonio 持续进行飞行训练。把 VX-6 设为 AM 扫军用波段——教学类通话的密度是民航侧完全没有的。更远的 Laughlin 和 Sheppard 也是训练基地。

stations.z: 休斯顿区调 · 航路与墨湾
stations.d: Handles Gulf of Mexico traffic including the helicopter operations serving offshore platforms, which is a distinctive thing to hear.
stations.dz: 负责墨西哥湾流量，包括为海上平台服务的直升机作业——这类通话很有特色。

stations.a: Draughon Miller Central Texas Regional Airport (KTPL)
Draughon Miller Central Texas Regional Airport (KTPL)
Draughon Miller Central Texas Regional Airport (KTPL)

stations.d: Texas has one of the most developed amateur storm-spotter networks in the world. When a supercell is approaching, the SKYWARN net on a local repeater gives you eyewitness reports of rotation and hail size well before any warning is issued. This is the single best argument for carrying a radio in Texas. Check RepeaterBook and your county ARES page for the active net frequency.
stations.dz: 德州拥有全球最成熟的业余风暴观测网络之一。超级单体来临时，本地中继上的 SKYWARN 通联网会在正式警报发布之前就给出目击者对旋转和冰雹尺寸的报告。这是在德州带一台电台最有力的理由。请在 RepeaterBook 和所在县的 ARES 页面查当前通联网频率。

stations.z: BNSF 与联合太平洋 · 扫 160.215–161.565
stations.d: Texas has more railroad route miles than any other state. Tower 55 in Fort Worth is one of the busiest at-grade crossings in the country and a well-known listening spot.
stations.dz: 德州的铁路里程全美第一。沃思堡的 Tower 55 是全美最繁忙的平面交叉之一，也是知名的收听地点。

stations.d: In a city that calls itself the live music capital, this is the station that earns it. Excellent local sessions.
stations.dz: 在一座自称现场音乐之都的城市里，这是真正撑得起这个名号的电台，本地现场录音很出色。

stations.z: KOOP 奥斯汀合作社电台
stations.d: Volunteer-programmed community radio, sharing the frequency with KVRX from UT Austin.
stations.dz: 志愿者编排的社区电台，与德州大学的 KVRX 共用频率。

stations.z: KPFT 休斯顿 Pacifica 台
stations.d: Notable for having been bombed off the air twice by the Klan in 1970, and for going straight back on.
stations.dz: 以 1970 年两次被三 K 党炸毁发射机而闻名——两次都立刻恢复播出。

stations.n: Mexican AM at night — scan 530–1710 kHz
stations.z: 夜间墨西哥中波 · 扫 530–1710 kHz
stations.d: South Texas at night pulls in high-power Mexican stations, the descendants of the old border blasters that once ran megawatt transmitters aimed at America.
stations.dz: 夜间的南德州能收到墨西哥的大功率电台——它们是当年那些对着美国发射、功率高达兆瓦级的“边境轰炸机”电台的后代。

stations.d: One of the most remote and least-visited national parks in the lower 48, with essentially no mobile coverage and no light pollution. Scan 162–174 MHz for ranger operations, and stay for the HF listening after dark.
stations.dz: 美国本土最偏远、访客最少的国家公园之一，基本没有手机信号也没有光污染。扫 162–174 MHz 可听护林员作业，天黑后留下来听短波。

stations.z: 美国边境巡逻队 · 联邦波段
stations.d: CBP works the federal 162–174 MHz block along the Rio Grande. Much is encrypted now, but scanning still finds analog traffic.
stations.dz: 海关与边境保护局沿格兰德河使用联邦 162–174 MHz。相当部分已加密，但扫描仍能找到模拟通话。

stations.d: West Texas at night is excellent for HF. Also 8.992, 11.175 and 15.016 MHz.
stations.dz: 夜间的西德州短波条件极佳。另有 8.992、11.175、15.016 MHz。

stations.d: Big Bend and the Llano Estacado have almost no RF noise floor.
stations.dz: 大弯地区和 Llano Estacado 高原几乎没有射频底噪。
